android.desc:
Clone and run multiple accounts of the same app simultaneously with ease using Parallel Space.
 
As a leading Android tool, it empowers over 200 million users to access multiple accounts on a single device. Enjoy enhanced privacy with the Incognito Installation feature, which makes apps invisible on your device to protect your privacy.
 
Parallel Space supports 24 languages and is compatible with most Android apps. Manage multiple accounts and safeguard your privacy with Parallel Space!
 
★ Log in to multiple accounts on one device
• Maintain separation between personal and work accounts
• Explore different game paths and level up multiple accounts simultaneously
• Keep each account's data separate and organized
 
★ Protect your privacy with hidden apps
• Safeguard sensitive apps in your private space, away from prying eyes
• Enhance privacy with a secure lock feature
 
★ Effortlessly switch between accounts
• Run multiple accounts at the same time and switch seamlessly with a single tap
 
Highlights:
• Powerful, stable, and user-friendly
• Unique: Built on multiDroid, the first application virtualization engine for Android
 
---
 
Notes:
• Limitation: Due to policy or technical limitations, some apps are not supported in Parallel Space, such as apps that declare the REQUIRE_SECURE_ENV flag.
• Permissions: Parallel Space requires necessary permissions to ensure the proper functioning of apps added within it. Rest assured that your privacy is our priority, and we do not collect personal information.
• Resource consumption: Most resource usage is attributed to the apps running inside Parallel Space. You can view specific resource usage in the 'Storage' and 'Task Manager' options within Parallel Space settings.
• Notifications: For optimal notification functionality of certain social networking apps within Parallel Space, consider adding Parallel Space to the whitelist or exceptional list of any booster or task management apps.
• Account conflict: For some social networking apps, each account must be associated with a unique mobile number. Ensure the provided number is active for the verification process during setup.
• Pro exclusive: With the free plan, you can run two accounts simultaneously. Unlock the ability to run multiple accounts by upgrading to the Pro plan.
